data.name: label8.Text
data.value: Booking Confirmation -All appointments are only confirmed once successfully submitted through the system. Accurate Information -Customers must provide correct name and contact details when making a booking. Arrival Time -Clients are expected to arrive on time for their appointment. Late arrivals may result in reduced service time or cancellation. Late Arrival Policy -If a client is more than 15 minutes late, the salon reserves the right to cancel or reschedule the appointment. Cancellation Policy -Appointments must be cancelled or rescheduled at least 24 hours in advance. No-Show Policy -Clients who fail to attend their appointment without notice may be restricted from making future bookings. Service Availability -All bookings are subject to staff and service availability. Double Booking Prevention -The system does not allow multiple bookings for the same time slot. Payment Terms -Payment is to be made at the salon after the service (or adjust if your system includes deposits). Changes to Appointments -The salon reserves the right to modify or reschedule appointments when necessary. Health & Safety -Clients should inform the salon of any allergies or scalp conditions before the appointment. System Use - This system is intended for booking salon services only. Misuse may result in restricted access.
